shadows.name: primary-glow
shadows.purpose: Soft accent glow under primary elements.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #605DFF; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.5s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4936F5; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border: 1px solid #605DFF; box-shadow: 0px 4px 4px 0px rgba(101, 96, 240, 0.10); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 50px; padding: 14px 16px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #D5D9E2; border-radius: 7px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #3A4252; transition: all 0.5s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748B; font-size: 14px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border: 1px solid #605DFF; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; color: #64748B; }

components.name: Active Sidebar Link
components.description: Active item in the left navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: block; padding: 12px 16px; background: #605DFF; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; }

components.name: Status Chip (Success)
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 50px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; } .ds-chip-success { background: #D8FFC8; color: #25B003; }

components.name: Table Header Cell
components.css: .ds-th { background: #F6F7F9; color: #445164; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; }

narrative.northStar: Dense indigo-violet operating dashboard on light surfaces, with a matching dark mode.
narrative.overview: BAN-PDM Jawa Timur is a school-accreditation management system (admin, asesor, end-user, and public landing page) built on the Trezo Bootstrap 5 admin template. Its visual world is a light, high-density operating dashboard with an indigo-violet accent, slate-blue text, and a matching dark mode. The design source of truth lives in the SCSS files under public/assets/scss/ (_variables.scss and the components/*.scss partials); Blade views consume it through Bootstrap utility and component classes.
keyCharacteristics: Light surfaces (white cards on a #F6F7F9 page) with a full dark-mode counterpart.
One accent — indigo-violet #605DFF — for primary actions, active navigation, and input focus.
Inter as the single typeface; bold dark-slate headings, muted slate body text.
Bootstrap 5 as the layout/component system; Tailwind is configured but not the source of truth.
Small radii (4px–8px) with pills (50px) reserved for avatars and status chips.
Two icon families split by surface: Remix for navigation, auth, and the public landing; Material Symbols for content and data views.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo Violet #605DFF is the only accent for actions and active states; semantic colors are reserved for status and feedback.

dos: Source colors from _variables.scss and consume them via Bootstrap theme-color utilities so dark mode keeps working.
Use Inter for all text; build hierarchy with weight (700) and the heading scale.
Keep radii at 4px / 7px / 8px; reserve 50px pills for avatars and status chips.
Show focus by switching border color to #605DFF (no shadow ring).
Keep motion at the system transition (all ease 0.5s).
Keep the icon split: Remix in navigation, auth, and the public landing; Material Symbols in content and data views.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color for primary actions; keep #605DFF as the single action accent.
Don't use Tailwind utilities for layout or color — Bootstrap is the source of truth.
Don't mix icon families within a single surface — Remix for navigation, auth, and the public landing; Material Symbols for content and data views; Feather is retired.
Don't use shadows for focus indication; the system communicates focus via border color.
